rationale: PINS the M14.1 Scala 3 extension fix: extension_definition wrappers never become parent symbols, so isExtension compared against a nonexistent field and was ALWAYS false. Now detected via ancestor chain + receiver type; emits Uses edge with isExtension marker. The line_number entries pin the M59 #825 follow-through: the receiver TYPE is written where the type node is — `extension (s: String)` names String on line 3, and the multi-line `extension (\n  x: Bla\n)` names Bla on line 11 — which need not be the method's line (4 / 13). The forbidRelationships entries are the pre-fix stamps (the method's declaration line), so reverting to the old stamp fails the gate instead of silently passing.

forbidRelationships.note: pre-fix defect: the receiver type Bla is written on line 11 (the extension clause); the old stamp reported the method's declaration line 13
same mechanism on the single-line case: String is named on line 3, the old stamp reported the method line 4
